notes.title: New Demo Release! V0.9.9.5
notes.notes:
[p][b]General[/b][/p][p]. Overall polish
. Bug fixes 
. General balancing
. Support for Ultra-wide screens
. Failing a level now results in losing lives instead of points 
. [b]Global leaderboard[/b] 
. After completing each tournament day, players are now presented with a selection of 4 passive upgrades[/p]

notes.title: v0.9.9.1
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
. Overall polish
. Bug fixes
. General balancing
. New pickup type
. Coupons were replaced for diamonds that you can collect throughout the levels
. New visuals for the stickers in collections
. Unlocking a sticker in collections now brings you to the respective check point
. Arcade mode restructured

notes.title: Update notes for V0.9.9
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
. Overall polish
. New levels for better game flow
. Re-imagine of the Arcade level - added new bonus and challenges to the level
. Added new feature - traps

notes.title: New Patch V.0.9.8
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
. Overall polish
. New levels for better game flow
. Teleport animation retouched
. New timer animation to better reflect the changes for time gained and lost
. Re-imagine of the Vision mechanic - now it slows time and adds more weight to the button press and more purpose o the mechanic itself
. The Arcade level is now a separate endless mode and is out of the main game with a dedicated high score
. Difficulty selection parameters adjustment
. Deleted modifiers selection - now only Challenge mode gives you a harder challenge
. The seconds left on timer, when finishing the level, are converted to score
. Coins value adjusted to the new difficulty modes 
. Coupons no longer unlock modifiers, only stickers

notes.title: New Feature Update
notes.notes:
Small update, BIG NEWS:
The new feature "Achievements" were just added to the demo!  You can now improve your Steam profile and show your support for the game by playing the demo!

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
General
. Overall polish.
. Unity Engine version update.
. Added key binding support for keyboard.
. Added localization support for Portuguese and Spanish.

Bugs
. Fixed bug in tutorial where you were not able to use the teleport

notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
General
. overall polish
. Small optimization pass
. Challenge mode no longer available for the demo version
. updated teleport feedback, to make it more visible where you end after using it. Added visual clues to give information on what teleport are connected.
. added resolution screen selection in the options menu for 16:9 variations.
. Updated Steam store page.
. Now demo has a dedicated store page, to try gather comments on the state of the demo and enjoyment.

notes.title: Major Demo Update V.0.9.3
notes.notes:
General
. overall polish
. new tutorial
. new levels
. Improved Game Flow
. keys are no longer random
. key system updated

Check it out and let us know what you think

notes.title: Major Demo Update V.0.8.0
notes.notes:
General
. main menu revamp
. checkpoint system revamp
. overall polish
. overall levels polished
. frame rate added
. simpler tutorial added
. initial zone reworked
. secret bonus coins removed and new star collectible added that now counts for completion
. maze layout normalized
. arcade endless mode added as a level
. score now counts as your life as well, and reaching zero resolves on game over
. door exit and key systems polished
. you only loses vision when the time starts
. new lose screen scene
. credits added
. difficulties added to the game at the start of each game

Balance
. player values adjusted
. coin values and numbers adjusted

Bugs
. opening screen volume fix
. vsync selection bug fixed

notes.title: Tangle Crisis Demo V.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]New Update![/b] Gameplay changes, new additions, new levels. Even if you have tried it before this new update address most of the feedback received so far. so don't be shy! 
Pick your controller or keyboard and give this new and improved experience a try. Join the Discord if you want to share your thoughts on the game, and Wishlist the game to be up to date on all the developments.
